## Chapecoense v Athletico Paranaense: relegation fight meets top-four push

Chapecoense host Athletico Paranaense in the Brasileirão on Monday, 12 October 2026 at Arena Condá, with the bottom club chasing survival momentum against fourth-placed opponents looking to consolidate Copa Libertadores qualification. [...] Verdão do Oeste are without Vinicius Lourenço, Rafael Carvalheira, Heitor and Max through injury, while Fernando is suspended. For Athletico-PR, Gaston Americo Benavidez and Renan Viana remain sidelined. [...] Furacão carry attacking threat, scoring 45 league goals with 50.17% shooting accuracy this season, and league top scorer Kevin Viveros leads the line with 19. Supply has come from Lucas Esquivel and João Cruz, both on five assists. Chape have conceded 57, but with nine headed goals and 23.59% crossing accuracy from open play, deliveries into the box could be their route.
